commit.message:
feat: log a steady walk as a treadmill workout

A walk is done on the treadmill, so it is a treadmill workout rather than a
new cardio activity: same machine, same color, same history lane. It differs
from the interval templates only in that its single `walk` interval is entered
per session instead of fixed.

It lives in the template library for the same reason exercise defaults live on
the exercise definition — the document IS the default. Logging a walk with
"this is the new default" ticked writes the entered pace and duration back to
the template, so the next walk prefills from it. The promotion runs before the
session is logged and aborts the log if it fails, mirroring the strength flow
so the two can never disagree.

A logged treadmill session with one interval is a steady one: the detail view
shows it as a pace instead of a one-row interval list, and the summary line
reads "3.4 mph" rather than "0 jog intervals".
